scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api,chain --prefix-colors green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run node -w chain"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.preview: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors green,magenta "npm run preview -w client" "npm run start -w server"
scripts.test: npm test -w client && npm test -w server && npm test -w chain
